name: Treant
body:
Treants are massive, long-lived guardians of the deep woodlands. Combining rough bark, sprawling leafy boughs, and roots that tap into the earth’s natural currents, these walking arbor-folk bring ancient woodland power, unmatched reach, and crushing force to their companions.

Standard Racial Traits
Ability Score Modifiers: Treants possess titanic physical strength and botanical resilience, but their ponderous bulk makes them slow. They gain +4 Strength, +2 Constitution, and -2 Dexterity.
Type: Plant. Treants are plants. Unlike standard plant monsters, treant player characters are not immune to mind-affecting effects. They remain immune to paralysis, poison, polymorph, sleep effects, and stunning.
Size: Large. Treants are Large creatures, taking a -1 size penalty to AC, a -1 size penalty on attack rolls, a +1 size bonus to CMB and CMD, and a -4 size penalty on Stealth checks. They occupy a 10-foot by 10-foot space and have a natural reach of 10 feet.
Speed: Normal. Treants have a base land speed of 30 feet.
Languages: Treants begin play speaking Common and Treant. Bonus languages include Aquan, Auran, Elven, Gnome, Sylvan, and Terran.
Defense Racial Traits
Barkskin: Thick, fibrous outer wood grants treants a +3 natural armor bonus to AC.
Vulnerability to Fire: Composed of dry timber and living branches, treants take half again as much (+50%) damage from fire attacks, regardless of whether a saving throw is allowed or succeeded.
Senses and Offense Racial Traits
Low-Light Vision: Treants can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.
Slam Attacks: A treant gains two primary slam natural attacks dealing 1d8 points of bludgeoning damage (plus Strength modifier).
Rock Throwing (Ex): A treant is skilled at throwing rocks and gains a +1 racial bonus on attack rolls when throwing rocks. A treant can fling rocks up to two size categories smaller than itself with a range increment of 60 feet. Damage deals 2d6 points of bludgeoning damage plus 1-1/2 times Strength modifier.
Skill and Magic Racial Traits
Arboreal Camouflage (Ex): In forested or jungle environments, a motionless treant can take 10 on Stealth checks even when observed, appearing in all aspects as a normal tree.
Forest Speak (Sp): At will, a treant can communicate with non-magical trees and plant life as if continuously under the effect of speak with plants.
